properties.name: HELICOPTER_BASIC_REPAIR_COST
properties.description: How much repair will cost if helicopter is slightly (1 hit) damaged (0 - 100000).

properties.name: HELICOPTER_SERIOUS_REPAIR_COST
properties.description: How much repair will cost if helicopter is seriously (2 hits) damaged (0 - 100000).

properties.name: HELICOPTER_BASIC_REPAIR_TIME
properties.description: How long repair will take if helicopter is seriously damaged (in hours, 1 - 255).

properties.name: HELICOPTER_BASIC_REPAIR_TIME_VARIATION
properties.description: HELICOPTER_REPAIR_TIME may randomly vary by this amount (in hours, 0 - 255).

properties.name: HELICOPTER_SERIOUS_REPAIR_TIME
properties.description: How long repair will take if helicopter is seriously damaged (in hours, 1 - 255).

properties.name: HELICOPTER_SERIOUS_REPAIR_TIME_VARIATION
properties.description: HELICOPTER_SERIOUS_REPAIR_TIME may randomly vary by this amount (in hours, 0 - 255).

properties.name: HELICOPTER_BASIC_COST_INCREASE_AFTER_BASIC_REPAIR
properties.description: How much cost of repairs will increase after every repair - for balancing reasons, and simulating parts scarcity (0 - 100000).

properties.name: HELICOPTER_BASIC_REPAIR_COST_MAX
properties.description: How much basic repair will cost at absolute maximum - to avoid immersion breaking ridiculous costs (0 - 1000000).

properties.name: HELICOPTER_SERIOUS_REPAIR_COST_MAX
properties.description: How much serious repair will cost at absolute maximum - to avoid immersion breaking ridiculous costs (0 - 1000000).

properties.name: HELICOPTER_DISTANCE_WITHOUT_REFUEL
properties.description:
How far can helicopter go without refuel if its tank is full (in sectors, 1-255). Note: distance between Drassen airport and Estoni equals 14 sectors.
Only used if alternative fuel system is on.
Vanilla-ish (technically it's wasn't used) JA2 - 25.

properties.name: HELICOPTER_HOVER_TIME_PER_FUEL_UNIT
properties.description:
How long can helicopter hover before using single fuel unit (in minutes, 1-255).
Only used if alternative fuel system is on.

properties.name: HELICOPTER_REFUEL_TIME
properties.description:
How long helicopter needs to fully refuel (in minutes, 1-255).
Only used if alternative fuel system is on.
Vanilla-ish (technically it's wasn't used) JA2 - 30.

properties.name: HELICOPTER_TIME_DELAY_FOR_HOVER_WAIT
properties.description:
How long can helicopter hover before Skyrider whines (in minutes, 1-255).
Only used if alternative fuel system is off.
Vanilla JA2 - 10.

properties.name: HELICOPTER_TIME_DELAY_FOR_HOVER_WAIT_TOO_LONG
properties.description:
How long can helicopter hover before Skyrider returns to base (in minutes, 1-255).
Only used if alternative fuel system is off.
Vanilla JA2 - 20.

properties.name: HELICOPTER_ASK_BEFORE_KICKING_PASSENGERS_OUT
properties.description: If TRUE, Skyrider won't automatically kick everyone out after running out of fuel, instead prompt will be shown.

properties.name: HELICOPTER_SAM_SITE_ACCURACY
properties.description:
Chance that helicopter gets hit by SAM attack when arriving at sector in hostile air zone (in percents).
Vanilla JA2 - 33.

properties.name: HELICOPTER_PASSENGER_HIT_CHANCE
properties.description: Chance per passenger he will get hurt when helicopter is hit (in percents).

properties.name: HELICOPTER_PASSENGER_HIT_MIN_DAMAGE
properties.description: Minimum damage passenger will take when hit in helicopter.

properties.name: HELICOPTER_PASSENGER_HIT_MAX_DAMAGE
properties.description: Maximum damage passenger will take when hit in helicopter.

properties.name: HELICOPTER_TOWN_LOYALTY_CHECK
properties.description: If FALSE, Skyrider will always fly when other conditions are satisfied, ignoring his associated town loyalty check. Vanilla JA2 - TRUE
